sources.entry: Ultra TabSaver - The Open Source Tab Manager for Safari [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/Swift-open-source/UltraTabSaver)
Ultra TabSaver - Ultra TabSaver is an open-source Tab Manager for Safari

summary.one_liner: Ultra TabSaver is an open-source Safari extension that saves the open tabs in a window as named Tab Groups so you can reopen, copy, or edit them later.
summary.what_it_does: The extension adds three main features to Safari: saving the current tab, saving all tabs in a window as a named Tab Group, and retrieving a single tab or a whole Tab Group. From a Tab Group you can open all its tabs with one click, rename it, copy all its URLs to the clipboard, add a URL, delete the group, or delete individual tabs. Saved data is stored in NSUserDefaults, keyed by Tab Group name, so two groups cannot share a name. The menu opens from the extension icon or by right-clicking a website. Recent README updates mention alphabetical sorting of Tab Groups and showing page descriptions.
use_cases: Save all open Safari tabs in a window for later
Reopen a saved set of tabs with one click
Copy a group of tab URLs to the clipboard
Organize browsing sessions into named tab groups
Manage and edit saved links inside Safari
how_to_run: Open the Xcode project and change the code signing settings to use your own certificate, or disable signing
In Safari, enable the Develop menu (Advanced tab of Safari preferences) if you want to run an unsigned extension
In Safari's Develop menu, check "Allow Unsigned Extensions" to load an unsigned build
See the README's "How to debug" section for more details
notable: Groups tabs into named Tab Groups that open all at once
Stores data locally in NSUserDefaults with no sync mentioned
Right-click menus for copying and deleting URLs within a group
Listed in awesome-mac under General Tools
caveats: Requires macOS Catalina or macOS Big Sur according to the README
Not yet on the Mac App Store; the author asks for funds to publish it
README lists a known performance issue: clicking the icon delays about 3 seconds before the popup appears
Drag and drop and keyboard shortcuts are listed as unfinished to-do items
